        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;

    int Mod = mod - 2;
    vector<ll> jc(n + 1), Jc(n + 1);
    jc[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) jc[i] = jc[i - 1] * i % mod;
    Jc[n] = qpower(jc[n], Mod);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) Jc[i] = Jc[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;

    vector<vector<ll>> C(n + 1, vector<ll>(n + 1, 0));
    C[0][0] = 1;

    }

    vector<ll> f(m + 1, 0), g(m + 1, 0);

            f[i] = (f[i] + f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            g[i] = (g[i] + ((g[j - 1] * f[i - j] + f[j - 1] * g[i - j]) % mod * (i + 1) + f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod * s) % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    int lim = min(m, n - m + 1);
    vector<vector<vector<ll>>> h(lim + 1, vector<vector<ll>>(m + 1, vector<ll>(2, 0)));
    h[0][0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
